name: mdh-import-watermark-sync
summary: Scheduled HTTPS -> MDH dataset sync: resumable full load, then semi-open incremental windows on a persisted watermark with a clock-skew safety lag; state in its own Data Storage collection.

dataset.description: MDH dataset that receives the records

state_dataset.description: Data Storage collection holding the single sync-state record (one per feed)

state_key.description: value of the state record's `key`, e.g. vendors / purchase_orders

id_keys.description: comma-separated natural key of a record; MDH PATCH-merges on it. Check uniqueness before trusting a single column - supplier numbers repeat across company codes

safety_lag_s.description: seconds each window closes BEHIND now, absorbing source-vs-Rossum clock skew

runtime_budget_s.description: wall-clock budget per run; must sit below the hook timeout (60s cap, 30s for a manual invoke)

full_operation.description: update = PATCH-merge page by page, resumable across runs; replace = buffer and PUT once, propagates deletions, refuses a truncated fetch, scope must fit one run

provenance: Lifted from three production master-data importers (vendors, purchase-order items, goods receipts) built 2026-08 for an SAP integration through a customer HTTPS middleware, themselves modelled on the SAP-BTP OData importers of an earlier implementation. Live-verified: full load of 17.5k rows in one run with replace; multi-run resumable full load of 3.7M PO items with update; exact window tiling; failure without watermark advance; backfill isolation. Generalized here and NOT yet run in this form - hence candidate.
notes: Only `SourceApi` knows the API - adapt its constants/methods, keep the engine. Copy delta-window key names VERBATIM from a working call (one deployed API misspells a key and ignores the corrected spelling). Stagger the cron against sibling importers: MDH has a single ingest worker and a row count read right after a load is a queue snapshot. The state record is a checkpoint, never a lock: MDH writes are async, so two runs seconds apart both see 'no state'.
